issues.description: Algorithmic complexity is O(N^2) in the worst case (nested loops over j and i with ~j iterations each). With N up to 3e5 this will not finish within time limits (TLE).

Off-by-one / invalid partition: the inner loop iterates i from j-1 down to 0 and uses prefix[i+1] and middle built from A[i+1..j-1], which includes iteration i==j-1 corresponding to an empty middle subarray (invalid per problem). This can produce incorrect answers.
No test files or automated tests were provided alongside the solution. Acceptance criteria require eliminating the observed TLE; no tests are present to assert correctness or performance.
